validation.typecheck: echo 'E2E validation - typecheck skipped (test files only)'

tasks.title: E2E Tests for Python Fixers
tasks.description: Validate ruff, black, isort, autoflake work in the pipeline
steps: Create test Python file with multiple issues (F401 unused imports, F632 assertions, formatting)
Run fix-agent pipeline targeting the file
Verify tier 2 tools are invoked before AI
Check fixed output matches expected results

tasks.title: E2E Tests for Go Fixers
tasks.description: Validate gofmt, goimports, golangci-lint work in the pipeline
steps: Create test Go file with formatting and unused imports
Run fix-agent pipeline
Verify goimports removes unused imports
Verify formatting is corrected

tasks.title: E2E Tests for Java Fixers
steps: Create test Java file with formatting issues + SonarQube violations
Run fix-agent pipeline
Verify google-java-format fixes formatting
Verify Sorald fixes S1155, S1132 rules
Verify PMD rules fall through to AI tier

tasks.title: E2E Tests for C++ Fixers
steps: Create test C++ file with formatting + modernization issues
Run fix-agent pipeline
Verify clang-tidy modernize-* checks are applied
Document any SDK path requirements for CI

tasks.title: E2E Tests for C# Fixers
steps: Create test C# project with formatting issues
Run fix-agent pipeline
Verify dotnet-format fixes formatting
Note: requires .csproj context

tasks.title: E2E Tests for TypeScript Fixers
steps: Create test TypeScript file with fixable ESLint issues
Run fix-agent pipeline
Verify ESLint fixes what it can
Verify @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any falls to AI tier

tasks.title: Test Against Real PR on Cloud Instance
tasks.description: Validate full pipeline on production-like environment
steps: Deploy to cloud instance (or use existing staging)
Find/create a real PR with code quality issues
Run fix-agent against the PR
Verify tier 1 → tier 2 → tier 3 cascade works
Document any cloud-specific configuration needed

tasks.title: Monitor Supabase Pattern Storage
tasks.description: Verify new patterns are saved correctly
steps: Run fixes that should create new patterns
Query Supabase for recently created patterns
Verify pattern structure is correct
Check success_rate tracking works

tasks.title: Integration Test: Full Fix Pipeline
steps: Create multi-language repo with issues across all languages
Run comprehensive fix-agent test
Verify tier 1 cache hits work
Verify tier 2 native tools are invoked
Verify tier 3 AI is used only when needed
Measure API call savings vs all-AI approach

tasks.title: Update Documentation with E2E Results
tasks.description: Document test coverage and any issues found
steps: Create E2E_TEST_RESULTS.md with test outcomes
Document any tool-specific quirks discovered
Update TIER2_FIXER_MATRIX.md if needed
Add E2E test commands to CI configuration
